q-5338.name: Question 1
q-5338.worked_solution:
The sum takes integer values of $n$ from $1$ to $3.$ So, computing the terms for $n=1,2,3$ and then adding them, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{n=1}^{3}5\cdot {2}^{n-1} & =(5\cdot {2}^{1-1})+(5\cdot {2}^{2-1})+(5\cdot {2}^{3-1}) \\  & =(5\cdot {2}^{0})+(5\cdot {2}^{1})+(5\cdot {2}^{2}) \\  & =(5\cdot 1)+(5\cdot 2)+(5\cdot 4) \\  & =5+10+20 \\  & =35.\end{aligned}
$$

The sum takes integer values of n from 1 to 3. So, computing the terms for n=1,2,3 and then adding them, we get

∑n=135⋅2n−1=(5⋅21−1)+(5⋅22−1)+(5⋅23−1)=(5⋅20)+(5⋅21)+(5⋅22)=(5⋅1)+(5⋅2)+(5⋅4)=5+10+20=35.

q-66995.name: Question 2
q-66995.worked_solution:
Notice that the terms of the corresponding sequence

$$
8,\,16,\,24,\,…,\,80,\,88.
$$

 are multiples of $8,$ and since $88÷8=11,$ there are $11$ terms in total. 

Therefore, the $n$th term of the sequence has the form

$$
{a}_{n}=8n,
$$

where $n$ ranges from $n=1$ to $n=11.$ Indeed: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{1} & =8(1)=8 \\ {a}_{2} & =8(2)=16 \\ {a}_{3} & =8(3)=24 \\  & \,\,⋮ \\ {a}_{10} & =8(10)=80 \\ {a}_{11} & =8(11)=88\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}S=8+16+24+⋯+80+88={\sum }_{n=1}^{11}8n.\end{aligned}
$$

Express S=8+16+24+⋯+80+88 in sigma notation.

a

c
∑n=1118n
d
∑n=111(8n+8)
e
∑n=111(n+8)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Notice that the terms of the corresponding sequence

8,16,24,…,80,88. are multiples of 8, and since 88÷8=11, there are 11 terms in total.

Therefore, the nth term of the sequence has the form an=8n, where n ranges from n=1 to n=11. Indeed:

a1=8(1)=8a2=8(2)=16a3=8(3)=24⋮a10=8(10)=80a11=8(11)=88

Therefore,

S=8+16+24+⋯+80+88=∑n=1118n.

q-251017.name: Question 3
q-251017.worked_solution:
The sum takes integer values of $m$ from $2$ to $5.$ So, computing the terms for $m=2,3,4,5$ and then adding them, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{m=2}^{5}\frac{2m+1}{10} & =\frac{2\cdot 2+1}{10}+\frac{2\cdot 3+1}{10}+\frac{2\cdot 4+1}{10}+\frac{2\cdot 5+1}{10} \\  & =\frac{5}{10}+\frac{7}{10}+\frac{9}{10}+\frac{11}{10} \\  & =\frac{5+7+9+11}{10} \\  & =\frac{32}{10} \\  & =\frac{\cancel{2}\cdot 16}{\cancel{2}\cdot 5} \\  & =\frac{16}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$
